name: Keyhunt
summary:
As skilled as I am at picking locks, getting the right key instead is sometimes preferable or even unavoidable. Over the years I've gathered quite a few keys
that might again prove useful one day, but most of them I simply kept for the
memories of jobs well done.

When I looked through my collection yesterday, I discovered a golden key decorated with a skull and the numbers 6 and 7. Although I couldn't remember
when or where I had obtained this particular key, I recognized its design: The very same depiction of a skull hangs over the entrance of Eastlawn Cemetery in Dayport, which likely means the key opens a crypt that's found in there.

With no better job in sight for the time being, I might as well try finding the
fitting lock. Who knows, maybe I'll come across a couple of sellable burial objects.
